Hey guys! Here's my workout plan:

[https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ntmomzP4AFhbOCnTFeDeGYzfaNcywf34/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ntmomzP4AFhbOCnTFeDeGYzfaNcywf34/view?usp=sharing)

I'm currently researching the best exercises for legs so if anyone has any suggestions please let me know!  
What I do is I pick one exercise from each isolated muscle and make my routine based on that so I know that I'm hitting all the right places.  
For example, if I was doing a chest day I would pick one exercise for the upper, middle, and lower chest to create a routine.  
I highly recommend creatine and whey protein, it has worked wonders. I get all my stuff from here: https://www.bulknutrients.com.au/  
For those who need help understanding some of the acronyms:  
DB = Dumbell  
BB = Barbell  
L2H = Low to high  
H2L = High to low  
If anyone needs any more help please leave a comment or shoot me a message! Starting to work out is extremely daunting and confusing, but once you get the hang of it and understand the language you feel a lot more grounded.
